annotations.title: Search land, units or buildings in a district or small area

description:
Find land parcels, property units or buildings matching search criteria — the
    sourcing tool. Give a `location` (place name, area code or postcode
    district) or a `bbox`.

    AREA LIMIT: one scan covers at most 150 km². A whole town or local
    authority (Harrogate, Cheltenham, Farnham, most boroughs) is usually larger
    and is refused with `area_too_large`, which lists the postcode districts
    covering it. Search a large place district by district: pass one postcode
    district per call as `location` ("HG1", then "HG2"), or a `bbox` no more
    than 0.5° on a side. Nothing is charged for a refused area.

    STRATEGY MODE (preferred). Pass a `strategy` key from
    `sourcing_strategies` with `lad_code` or `postcode_district`, and the
    search runs the published preset: its filters, its ranking, and a
    `score_components` breakdown on every row saying which term earned what.
    Override any published filter with `strategy_overrides` — `{"min_yield_pct":
    8}` — or pass null for a key to switch that filter off. An unknown key is
    rejected rather than ignored. `listing_state` restricts to on- or
    off-market units; page with `cursor` from `next_cursor`. Strategy mode
    ignores the legacy filters below.

    Filter land by use class and `max_built_coverage` (built footprint as a
    share of plot, so 0.2 finds substantially empty plots), units by type,
    bedrooms, EPC band and tenure, and either by owner — `min_years_owned` is
    the usual off-market signal, and `owner_types` separates companies from
    public bodies.

    Returns parcels with ownership attached where the bulk register knows it.
    For land or units, use sourcing_owners to resolve a specific set afterwards.

    PARKS, HEATHS, RAILWAYS, CEMETERIES AND UTILITY LAND ARE EXCLUDED BY
    DEFAULT. The scan is ordered by parcel size, and the largest parcels in any
    area are its open spaces — unfiltered, a Camden search returned Regent's
    Park, Hampstead Heath, a cemetery and railway land as its top six, while
    13,047 residential parcels in the same borough never appeared. Pass
    `include_undevelopable=True` to see them; they come back with no indicative
    land value, because a residual on a heath is a meaningless number that
    reads as an authoritative one.

    BUILDINGS: asset="buildings" searches recorded footprints with footprint
    area, storey count, unit count, dominant EPC and tenure. Supply one location,
    bbox or drawn polygon. Results include matching footprints and stable
    building IDs for linked-unit inspection. Page with offset, limit up to 100.
    Unit/owner/strategy criteria are rejected for buildings.

    INVENTORY PAGINATION: for land or units, supply offset=0, then next_offset
    while has_more is true. These bounded pages apply every criterion before
    pagination; derived-score/strategy criteria are not accepted in this mode.
    Unit size uses min/max_floor_area_m2; land and buildings use min/max_area_m2.
    Repeated warehouse reads are cached for five minutes. Results remain metered
    by the gateway. No unknown tenure or EPC is asserted to meet a positive filter.

    UK only. Costs 40 credits (40p).

SourcingBBox.description: A geographic bounding box in EPSG:4326.
SourcingBBox.title: SourcingBBox

cursor.description: STRATEGY MODE ONLY: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Inventory pages use `offset`.
cursor.title: Cursor

lad_code.description: STRATEGY MODE scope (GSS code, e.g. E09000032). Without a strategy, pass the code as `location` instead.
lad_code.title: Lad Code

listing_state.description: STRATEGY MODE ONLY, units only: restrict to on- or off-market units. Rejected without `strategy`. For what is on the market now use `sourcing_live_listings`.
listing_state.title: Listing State

postcode_district.description: STRATEGY MODE scope (e.g. SW11). Without a strategy, pass it as `location`.
postcode_district.title: Postcode District

strategy.description: A preset key from `sourcing_strategies`. Turns on strategy mode.
strategy.title: Strategy

strategy_overrides.description: STRATEGY MODE ONLY. Values for the preset's own filter keys.
strategy_overrides.title: Strategy Overrides
